summary: Dedicated customer request: clearer cost reporting ($/1M output tokens) by model/region for Dedicated capacity
description:
Issue summary
AcmeAssist (Dedicated tier) is asking for clearer cost reporting for their Dedicated deployment. They want a breakdown that looks like: blended $/1M output tokens with drilldowns by model, model version/quantization profile (if applicable), and region. Their current view (monthly invoice + high-level usage exports) doesn’t help them attribute cost changes to model mix, output length, caching/batching efficiency, or region.

Customer impact
- Customer is trying to justify Dedicated expansion internally and needs a defensible breakdown of unit costs for QBR/finance review.
- Without a breakdown, they are attributing cost spikes to “platform inefficiency” and are asking for manual ad-hoc reports.
- Risk: renewal friction and increased support load from repeated billing/cost questions.

Customer request (what they asked for)
1) Dedicated cost metric aligned to tokens: blended $/1M output tokens for a selected time range.
2) Drilldowns: model (and version), region, and (if possible) endpoint/route.
3) A way to export monthly and QTD summaries (CSV is fine).
4) Clarification on definitions: how idle capacity is treated, and how shared overhead is allocated.

Current state / constraints (internal)
- We have internal work underway for an Internal “Unit Economics” dashboard with finance-aligned definitions and drilldowns (model/region/tier).
- That dashboard is currently internal-only (RBAC restricted) and includes cost attribution logic not yet packaged for customer-facing delivery.
- Dedicated invoicing today is primarily contract/commit + capacity utilization reporting; token-level unit economics is not exposed as a product feature.
- Known data gaps in the past: streaming output token metering parity and some dimension normalization; improved recently but still treated as internal metrics until Finance signoff gates are met.

Notes on feasibility / future externalization
- This request is a strong signal for a future external feature: customer-facing cost visibility (especially for Dedicated + Private where customers need more detailed reporting).
- Product note (Marissa): v1 internal dashboard is meant to be the “source of truth” and should be stabilized first (reconciliation + SLOs). After v1 is stable, we can consider a curated external report/export that reuses the same metric definitions but hides sensitive internal allocation details.
- Finance note: any customer-facing unit cost number needs to be explicitly labeled (blended vs marginal) and have a stable rate card version for the reporting period; otherwise customers will compare month-over-month changes driven by internal rate-card updates.

Proposed immediate path (what Support/CS can offer now)
- Provide a one-time curated report to AcmeAssist for the requested time range, using internal aggregates where available, with clear caveats:
  - metric is “blended” (includes idle allocation per current internal methodology)
  - rate card version/date used
  - regions included and any missing-dimension coverage
- Offer a repeatable monthly export for the next 1–2 cycles as a Customer Success deliverable (manual / semi-manual), while we validate readiness for externalization.

Open questions to confirm with customer
- Do they want blended (all-in) or marginal (active GPU time only) costs for Dedicated?
- Do they want costs normalized by output tokens only, or input+output tokens?
- Time boundary expectations: calendar month in their timezone vs UTC.

Acceptance criteria for closing this support ticket
- Customer receives a clear answer on what Redwood can provide now vs later.
- Customer gets an initial report (or a committed plan with dates) and agrees to the interim approach.
- A product follow-up is recorded (internal) to evaluate external-facing reporting, but this Jira issue remains a support artifact (not a project plan).
comments: 2025-02-18 10:14 PT — Allison Grant (Reporter): Logged per CSM escalation. AcmeAssist asking for per-model + per-region cost reporting for Dedicated. They specifically asked for $/1M output tokens and monthly export. Routing to Product (Console) + Finance methodology for guidance on what we can share safely.

2025-02-18 13:02 PT — Marissa Cole (Assignee): Acknowledged. This aligns with internal Unit Economics dashboard goals, but we are not ready to externalize the UI. Suggest we provide a curated export for this customer as a stopgap after confirming (a) blended vs marginal preference and (b) timezone/month boundaries. Please include caveats: blended includes idle allocation and uses finance rate card versioned for the period.

2025-02-19 09:27 PT — Rishi Malhotra (FP&A): For any shared number: must cite rate card version (e.g., 2025Q4) and allocation policy (idle included; overhead treatment). Recommend we label the metric “Redwood blended cost” and avoid implying it matches invoice line items exactly. Reconciliation typically within a tolerance band depending on timing windows.

2025-02-19 11:40 PT — Allison Grant: Replied to customer: we can provide a monthly export with blended unit cost and breakdown by model + region for their Dedicated usage, with definitions and caveats. Asked customer to confirm whether they want blended vs marginal and whether UTC month boundaries are acceptable.

2025-02-21 15:18 PT — Customer (AcmeAssist): Thanks. We prefer blended (all-in) for internal planning. UTC month boundaries are fine. Need a QTD view and last full month, with model breakdown and us-east vs eu-west split. CSV export works.

2025-02-24 10:06 PT — Allison Grant: Internal note: We can produce a CSV from internal aggregates for Feb QTD + Jan full month; include columns: date (day), model_id (normalized), region (canonical), output_tokens, blended_cost_usd, blended_usd_per_1m_output_tokens. Exclude any customer-identifying top-N beyond their own account. Ensure we do not disclose internal GPU rate-card line items; provide only the derived metric + methodology summary.

2025-02-26 16:30 PT — Marissa Cole: Please add explicit disclaimer to the export: (1) metric is for cost transparency/diagnostics, (2) not a billing statement, (3) subject to small adjustments due to late-arriving telemetry/backfills, (4) rate card version pinned for the report period. Also note that quantization profile drilldown is not reliably available for all models yet; keep it out unless coverage is >99%.

2025-02-28 09:05 PT — Allison Grant: Sent AcmeAssist the Jan + Feb QTD CSV export via CSM along with a 1-page methodology note and definitions (blended $/1M output tokens, included costs, idle treatment). Offered to repeat monthly for next 2 cycles while we evaluate a productized solution.

2025-03-01 14:22 PT — Customer (AcmeAssist): Received, this is what we needed. The blended vs invoice note is helpful. Please plan to send this monthly; we’ll revisit if/when it becomes available in Console.
resolution: Provided customer with a curated CSV export (Jan full month + Feb QTD) showing blended $/1M output tokens with model and region breakdown, plus methodology caveats (blended/all-in, idle included, rate card version pinned, not a billing statement). Customer confirmed this meets immediate need; ongoing monthly exports to be handled via CSM as an interim measure. Product to evaluate future externalization separately.

Product: capture as input for potential customer-facing cost reporting once internal Unit Economics dashboard reaches stability gates (reconciliation + SLOs + RBAC).
